entities.name: Syr Vondam
entities.description: High-ranking human Solar Knight of the Sunstar Free Company who survived a sekhar bead through his head and hunted the Endstone.

entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: Monoist who threw the bead that pierced Vondam and obtained the Endstone.

entities.name: Slats
entities.description: Astelli captain who prophesied Vondam's death.

entities.name: Endstone
entities.description: Dangerous object that revised the timeline.

entities.name: Infinite Guideline Station
entities.description: Station where Vondam fought Haliya and Alpharael.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: The sun the Sunstar sought to revive.

events.summary: Monoists attack the Dawnsire; Slats prophesies Vondam's death and Alpharael throws the bead through his head, apparently killing him.
events.quote: it went directly through Syr Vondam's head, apparently killing him

events.summary: After the Endstone's timeline revision Vondam survives with a hole in his head and vows to pursue Alpharael.
Vondam deduces the Endstone manipulated events to draw Alpharael to it.
events.quote: it was his burden and doom to deliver the object to his superiors

events.summary: Vondam and Haliya track Alpharael to Kavaron; after Haliya fails he orders the massacre of Taro-duend and surrenders.
events.quote: he enacted protocol seven, ordering the massacre of all 6,000 inhabitants of Taro-duend

events.summary: Vondam fights Haliya and Alpharael and is disabled, begging to be finished; they leave.
events.quote: Haliya separated the vertebrae in Vondam's neck

relations.quote: believes her to be the most promising candidate he has ever trained
Solar Knight of the Sunstar Free Company
Vondam pledged to go after Alpharael
